name: Home media server on an old laptop

mentions.name: Home media server on an old laptop
mentions.description: This project turns a 2018 laptop that is no longer useful as an everyday machine into a home media server for watching movies. The build so far involves learning about networking, containers, codecs, and ffmpeg.
mentions.audience: Old laptop no longer useful as an everyday tool; repurposed rather than discarded.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been getting back into movies this year and my 2018 laptop has reached the stage where it’s no longer useful as an everyday tool, so I’m turning it into a home media server.

evidence.value: I’ve been getting back into movies this year and my 2018 laptop has reached the stage where it’s no longer useful as an everyday tool, so I’m turning it into a home media server.
